name: detectors/multipart
description: multipart/form-data: a sensitive part is replaced whole, a text file part goes through the generic pass, boundaries survive.

steps.input:
POST /u HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----b

------b
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="password"

secret1
------b
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="a.txt"
Content-Type: text/plain

hello admin@corp.io
------b--

expect.equals:
POST /u HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----b

------b
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="password"

[PASSWORD_1]
------b
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="a.txt"
Content-Type: text/plain

hello user1@target1.example
------b--
